slides.title: How did Sudan answer Ethiopia's consulate closure?
Sudan closes Ethiopia's consulate
slides.body: In Gedaref. Two Sudanese officials told Reuters.

slides.title: Ethiopia acted first
slides.body: It closed Sudan's Assosa consulate and gave six staff 48 hours.

slides.title: Accusations on both sides
slides.body: Sudan says RSF used Ethiopian land. Ethiopia denies it, and says Sudan backs Tigray rebels. Sudan denies.

slides.title: Dialogue, not escalation.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
